visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white oversized hoodie, is shown in a close-up shot. She is speaking animatedly with a wide smile, her hands raised and gesturing outward. The background is a plain, neutral-colored wall with bright, even lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of the same woman sitting at a white table. She has her fingers pressed to her temples in a 'thinking' gesture, looking down slightly with a focused expression. (3) She begins to describe a creative vision, using her hands to mimic the movement of waves and wind. Above her head, small square inset videos appear showing crashing ocean waves and sunlight filtering through forest leaves. Her facial expressions are highly expressive, moving from deep thought to excitement. (4) The woman continues her description, now miming the use of a pipette and drawing a heart shape with her hands. New inset videos show a laboratory setting with a glass dropper and a skincare product bottle. She then moves her hands to mimic bubbles and a wide panning shot. Insets show white bubbles and close-up skincare application. The lighting remains consistent, and the camera is static throughout.
